method: tools/firmware.py decodes each configured Thumb BL return-PC, follows either a direct target or one aligned LDR.W PC absolute veneer with Thumb bit, and checks any declared call-site metadata against the filter.
validation: Exact AP identity and 64 configured caller filters pass; tools/tests/test_firmware.py exercises direct and veneer calls, mismatched target, inconsistent metadata, absent primary caller, invalid Thumb bit and non-BL instruction.
limitations: Static call destination validation does not prove ABI, semantic scope, object lifetime, all-thread quiescence, or behavior on device. Indirect calls and other veneer forms need separate verifier support.
